fields.name: Tiled
fields.summary: If true, this layer is tiled as the camera scrolls around.             If false, this layer only shows up around it's home position.

fields.name: ControlHomePosition
fields.summary: A position relative to the centre of a ParallaxControl that this parallax should be drawn at, in pixels.             Used for menus.             Note that this is ignored if the parallax layer is tiled - in that event a random pixel offset is used and slowness is applied.

fields.name: WorldHomePosition
fields.summary: The "relative to ParallaxAnchor" starting world position for this layer.             Essentially, an unclamped lerp occurs between here and the eye position, with Slowness as the factor.             Used for in-game.

fields.name: WorldAdjustPosition
fields.summary: An adjustment performed to the world position of this layer after parallax shifting.             Used for in-game.             Useful for moving around Slowness = 1.0 objects (which can't otherwise be moved from screen centre).

fields.name: Slowness
fields.summary: Multiplier of parallax shift.             A slowness of 0.0f anchors this layer to the world.             A slowness of 1.0f anchors this layer to the camera.

fields.name: Scrolling
fields.summary: Should the parallax scroll at a specific rate per second.

Content.Client.Options.OptionsVisualizer.summary: A single option for a layer to be selected.

fields.name: Options
fields.summary: Which options must be set by the user to make this datum match.

fields.name: Data
fields.summary: The sprite layer data to set on the sprite when this datum matches.

Content.Client.Light.Components.ColorCyc.summary: A light behaviour that cycles through a list of colors.

fields.name: Sprite
fields.summary: The RSI path for the damage visualizer                  group overlay.

fields.name: Color
fields.summary: The color of this sprite overlay.                 Supports only hexadecimal format.

fields.name: Name
fields.summary: The name to use for this changelog.                 If left unspecified, the name of the file is used instead.                 Used during localization to find the user-displayed name of this changelog.

fields.name: Entries
fields.summary: The individual entries in this changelog.                 These are not kept around in memory in the changelog manager.

fields.name: AdminOnly
fields.summary: Whether or not this changelog will be displayed as a tab to non-admins.                 These are still loaded by all clients, but not shown if they aren't an admin,                 as they do not contain sensitive data and are publicly visible on GitHub.

fields.name: Order
fields.summary: Used when ordering the changelog tabs for the user to see.                 Larger numbers are displayed later, smaller numbers are displayed earlier.
